text: Sanborn's misspellings and raised letters spell short strings such as QUA, LOE and YAR. The experiment tried each as a short second key added to a puzzle word, one letter of each at every place.
Drawn for KRYPTOS and QUA on the standard alphabet: at place 22 the two key letters add to 0, so the carved F reads F where the message has E.
451,440 settings: the best, KNOWS with QEAU, lands 8 of 24; ten shuffled coppers searched the same way land 7 to 11. Chance.
